newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-AFRICAN CLUB COMPETITIONS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AFRICAN CLUB COMPETITIONS DRAW.

text.p: The draw for the second round of the three African club competitions:
Desportivo Travadores (Cape Verde Islands) or Mouloudia Alger (Algeria) v Udoji United (Nigeria)
Unisport Bafang (Cameroon) or Munisport (Congo) v Ferroviario Maputo (Mozambique)
Africa Sports (Ivory Coast) v Primiero Agosto (Angola)
Caps United (Zimbabwe) v Orlando Pirates (South Africa)
Red Stars FC (Seychelles) v St Louissienne (Reunion)
Nchanga Rangers (Zambia) v Arab Contractors (Egypt, holders)
FC 105 Libreville (Gabon) v Royal Armed Forces (Morocco)
Hearts of Oak (Ghana) v Etoile Sahel (Tunisia)
Umeme (Uganda) or Racing Bafoussam (Cameroon) v Mouloudia Oran (Algeria)
AS Bantous (Zaire) v Kampala City Council (Uganda)
Asante Kotoko (Ghana) v Stade Malien (Mali) or USM Ein Beida (Algeria)
Team mentioned first plays at home in the first leg on the weekend of May 2-4. The return leg will be played on the weekend of May 16-18. The winners qualify for the quarter-finals in September.
